description: To co-create India’s largest AI ecosystem hub focused on talent development, innovation, and responsible AI adoption across the state.
body_lead: To co-create India’s largest AI ecosystem hub focused on talent development, innovation, and responsible AI adoption across the state. Chennai : Tiger Analytics, a global leader in AI and advanced analytics consulting, today announced the signing of a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of Bihar at the India-AI Impact Summit 2026, organized by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). The partnership aims to establish one of India’s largest Artificial Intelligence Centres of Excellence (AI CoE) in Bihar.
